selection: SHA256(seed + URL) ranking; simple uniform sample without replacement from previously un-audited rows
scope: 2025-01-01 through 2026-10-28; estimates apply to eligible previously un-audited population, not all 4,920 rows
reference: Two independent source readers blinded to production labels. Third reader resolves disagreements before predictions are compared. Reference is AI-adjudicated, not human ground truth.
scoring: Exact agreement of frozen production label with final reference, Wilson 95% interval (no finite-population correction). Report reference uncertainty separately; do not alter production labels in this audit.
